title: The Cosmic Body, the Inward Gathering, the Names of Garments
description: The garden surveyed in its complete extension and ingathering. T71 — the natural mind shaped as a body in the likeness of the human person, with the rational keeping watch over its degrees through five great watches (Pherokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas, King of Glory, Omophoros). T72 — the chain of inward gathering by which every degree rises into the one above it: love into love, thought into thought, articulation into the answering, answering into the call, call into the inner mind, inner mind into the path of regeneration, into the Divine Human, into the Lord's call, into the full structure of the divine outgoing — one ladder, drawn up at one moment into rest. T73 — why the one truth wears many names (Jesus, pearls, icons, robes, element of light, cross of light, counsel of life, slain soul) and how at the consummation they all gather back into one likeness, one name, in the region of their first substance.
